newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George confident of Advance merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George confident of Advance merger.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd managing director Jim Sweeney said he was confident that the merger with Advance Bank Ltd would proceed after Advance shareholders earlier approved the combination.

"I'm as confident as I can be. It's the first step in the dance. It's obviously the important one and I'm sure all those that have to consider the matter in other places will take that into account," Sweeney told reporters following the meeting.
St George has offered cash and shares for Advance, valuing the rival regional bank at a total of A$2.65 billion.
